article.title: Right of adverse party as to writing used to refresh memory
article.content: Any writing referred to under the provisions of the two last preceding sections shall be produced and shown to the adverse party if he requires it; such party may, if he pleases, cross-examine the witness thereupon.
article.html:
164Right of adverse party as to writing used to refresh memory

Section 164 · Part IV · Chapter X

Any writing referred to under the provisions of the two last preceding sections shall be produced and shown to the adverse party if he requires it; such party may, if he pleases, cross-examine the witness thereupon.
